text: Let's go through every step of creating your first invoice in the ByggExp app.
Choose Skicka faktura eller offert – the app guides you step by step.
First, we fill in the company details. They are added to every invoice, quote and self-inspection, so you only enter them once.
Save – and the first step is done.
Next, we add a customer. You choose a private person or a company – we pick a company.
The company name is enough, but everything you fill in appears neatly on the invoice.
The customer is saved in the system. Next time you just pick it – the address and all details are filled in on the invoice automatically.
Here you choose payment terms and other settings that apply to every invoice for this customer.
In the next step, we create an item – what you sell, for example concrete work.
You choose the VAT rate, and the item is saved so you can use it on all future invoices.
We pick the customer we created earlier. Payment terms, due date and your reference are filled in automatically.
Then we choose the project. The order reference comes from the project, and the project name goes into the description.
We pick the item and enter, for example, 58 hours at 595 kronor.
Done – your first invoice is sent!
The next invoice is even faster – the customer and the item are already there.
